sources.title: Free AI Keyword Intent Classifier (4 Intent Types) | Grigora
sources.snippet: Search intent is the foundation of modern SEO. Match content to intent or you do not rank. The classifier tags each keyword with one of four intents: informational, navigational, transactional, commercial. Bulk classify hundreds of keywords. Use the labels to plan content types: blog posts for informational, product pages for transactional.
